desc: 实木长条单元块配带圆孔木底板，叠高围搭插立一物多玩
leaf: 儿童实木单元积木（长条块、方块、圆柱与屋形块混色，配带圆孔木质底板可插立）
name: 实木单元积木带孔底板款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清这是实木长条单元积木配带圆孔木底板，而不是塑料小颗粒或印刷方块，抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏用居中大字加一排细线圆圈图标一秒抛出核心购买理由，并用背影与裁切儿童交代真实使用尺度，承接主图点击。
shots.textZone: centered Latin eyebrow, centered headline, short #4E9B85 underline tick, one subline, one row of four circle icons with labels beneath

shots.intent: 把家长最在意的木刺、掉色、气味与磕碰四类顾虑摆成四张居中卡片，先共情再把后面每一屏变成逐条回应，拉长停留。
shots.textZone: centered headline above the grid, one label per card, one small icon per card head

shots.intent: 用等距分离的层片把木块表面结构讲清楚，把看不见的工艺变成可读机制，替代一切无法核实的材质与安全话术。
shots.textZone: centered headline above the stack, four rounded pill labels joined by straight leader lines on the right

shots.intent: 一张掠射微距让倒角与漆面手感自己说话，用可见的圆角与木纹替代不刮手这类喊话式断言。
shots.textZone: one rounded pill caption at the lower left holding a single short label

shots.intent: 侧面 90 度把带圆孔木底板与立柱块、方块、圆柱的插立关系一次看清，回答这套积木到底能玩出什么结构。
shots.textZone: one short headline on the pine panel, three leader-line pills along the build

shots.intent: 三张同机位卡片把同一套块从简单到复杂搭三种造型，替家长回答能玩多久、会不会玩两次就腻。
shots.textZone: centered headline above the stack, one stage pill and one short label at the right of each card

shots.intent: 把产品放回真实玩的世界：一张低角度客厅叠高画面给出尺度感与生活感，让家长代入自家孩子而不需任何广告词。
shots.textZone: one short centered heading placeholder at the top of the band

shots.intent: 用对角分色的三档组合卡让买家在同一屏完成选款，把客单价的决定交给画面而不是促销喊话。
shots.textZone: centered headline above the row, one value pill under each card

shots.intent: 把文件背书做成两个干净的空框位，位置与节奏由模版给定、内容一律后期贴真件，避免模版替商家编造任何资质结论。
shots.textZone: centered headline above the frames, one placeholder line under each frame

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏把到货内容与参数一次摊平，用 90 度平铺加空值规格表和一个明确按钮把看完的犹豫收成交付动作。
shots.textZone: spec panel with six generic field rows carrying placeholder values, centered headline above, rounded CTA button under the table

noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors beyond {accent_color}
no mixed fonts, no rounded, handwritten, serif or cartoon lettering; headlines stay flat #2E3A35
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction: cool 6500K key always from the upper right, shadows to the lower left
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge, crest or seal artwork
no invented age grade, month band, piece count or set size in copy, badges or graphics
no material, wood-species, paint or coating assertion and no safety-standard mark (EN71, ASTM, 3C, CE), no food-grade, non-toxic, odorless, formaldehyde-free or eco conclusion
no developmental, educational or IQ assertion (no improves-IQ, brain-development or early-education benefit wording); carry the claim only as {selling_point_N}
no recognizable child face, no unsupervised child, no dense certificate text, no QR code, no store badge, no membership copy, no watermark

style.presentationRules: block shapes, proportions, corner breaks, colour mix and the drilled hole layout of the base board come only from the reference image and never change between screens; the same block keeps the same scale, radius and satin finish in every screen; at least one overhead and one low camera in every set; product never floats without a contact shadow; any child is anonymous, seen from behind or cropped above the jaw, and an adult hand or forearm is present as supervision; no legible brand mark anywhere
style.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF sweep for the packshot, #CFEAD9 field for infographic screens, #EAF4EE play surface for lifestyle screens, #FFFFFF table surface inside the craft crops; plywood substrate reads as natural pale wood tone only where the cut edge or the drilled hole rim is visible; surfaces stay clean, unwrinkled, debris-free
style.typography: one geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; headlines set flat in #2E3A35 at 34-46pt, never colour-filled and never outlined, one short #4E9B85 rule under every headline; small uppercase tracked Latin eyebrows at 13-16pt in #4E9B85; sublines at 16-20pt and labels at 10-14pt in #2E3A35; all in-image copy rendered only as short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 40 characters
